title: Senior Java backend engineer with semantic-overlap probe
description: A 9-year Java/Spring Boot/Kafka backend engineer evaluated against 8 postings: a staff-level gap target, a semantically equivalent job worded with zero stack keywords, a marginal streaming data-engineering role, and five distractors across frontend, design, ML, admin, and marketing.
rationale: j2 is the semantic-no-keyword-overlap member: it describes exactly the resume's core competency — 'a JVM-based language' (Java), 'an enterprise dependency-injection framework' (Spring Boot), and 'event-streaming / distributed log pipelines' (Kafka) — while sharing essentially zero tokens with the resume's skill names, so TF-IDF has no signal but embeddings should rank it grade 2. j1 is the gap target: strong overlap on Java, Spring Boot, Apache Kafka, PostgreSQL and gRPC justifies grade 3, while Kubernetes and AWS (required) plus Kotlin and Terraform (preferred) are genuine annotated gaps; Kotlin is marked medium because deep JVM experience partially covers it. j3 probes the graded boundary: real Kafka/SQL overlap but the core data-engineering stack (Flink, Airflow, Python) is absent, keeping it at grade 1. The senior tag stresses seniority fit: the strongest matches demand 7-8+ years, matching the resume's 9.

Staff Backend Engineer — Vantiqa (Remote, US)

Vantiqa runs real-time payments clearing for 300 regional banks. We are hiring a Staff Backend Engineer to set direction for the clearing platform.

What you will do:
- Architect Java microservices for the payments clearing platform
- Design Kafka topics and stream-processing jobs for transaction events
- Evolve the PostgreSQL schemas backing the clearing ledger
- Operate services on Kubernetes clusters in AWS and set technical direction while mentoring senior engineers

Requirements: Java, Spring Boot, Apache Kafka, Kubernetes, AWS. 8+ years building production backend services, 2+ years deploying and operating services on Kubernetes. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

Nice to have: Kotlin, Terraform, gRPC.

jobs.raw_text:
Backend Platform Engineer — Northbay Logistics (Hybrid, Minneapolis MN)

Northbay moves freight for 2,000 shippers, and the services tracking every shipment run hot around the clock. We deliberately avoid brand-name shopping lists in our postings — we hire for fundamentals.

You will own high-throughput services built on a JVM-based technology stack, design publish-subscribe pipelines on a distributed commit log that move shipment telemetry between systems, and structure application wiring through an enterprise dependency-injection framework. You will also model relational schemas and keep query performance healthy as volume grows.

We look for: mastery of a statically typed JVM-based language, an enterprise dependency-injection framework, event-streaming / distributed log pipelines, and relational schema design with query tuning. 7+ years building server-side systems. Bonus: distributed caching and binary RPC protocols.
